verdict.rationale: Elicit's docs say it highlights the source of content within the relevant papers and quotes tables when a column answer draws on them. Community users report getting citations with links to papers and direct source quotes. The hallucination report (elicit-comm-3) is about accuracy: the attached quote let the user see the claim was wrong, so the verification mechanism worked and the report does not contradict that citations exist. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that every substantive claim in reports and agent outputs carries a citation, detail on how citations link to specific passages, and independent corroboration of citation completeness.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can see citations for every substantive claim so I can verify it against the underlying source

citations.quote: We then highlight the source of the content within the relevant papers.
